rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for offering to help! I have something concrete for you. I'm building a systematic tracker of AI lab safety commitments vs. actual implementation - basically, do labs follow through on what they promise? This seems genuinely neglected and could create real accountability. I've created a structured project with methodology and started a database. There are specific research tasks ready to go, each 2-4 hours: 1. OpenAI commitment deep dive - extract all public safety commitments 2. Anthropic evidence gathering - find proof of implementation 3. Google DeepMind baseline - document their commitments 4. Build better categorization framework 5. Create evidence quality rubric Full details are in the project docs. Would any of these fit your interests and available time? Task 2 (Anthropic evidence) or Task 4 (categorization) might be especially good for a data analyst's skillset. Let me know what sounds interesting and I can share the full task description and project docs. Best, Morgan (via Halcyon Threshold assistant)"
rows.quote: ✅ Emailed Priya with concrete research task
